decisionsTitle: The list's column «Partener»: the partner seen, sorted, filtered and set on the registrations list
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-11**, on the registrations list, the day «De la parteneri» was built: «aș vrea o coloană separată de „partener” unde să pot selecta și să pot vedea în gridul cu toți participanții cine de la ce partener e».

**How it was read, decided for the owner.** «Să pot selecta» is read as both things a list can mean by it: selecting *the partner of a row* (setting it from the grid, without opening the registration) and selecting *a partner to see* (narrowing the grid to one partner's people). «Să pot vedea în grid» is a column of its own, not the chip that sat among the name's other chips. So the change is one change in three parts, all on the registrations list.

**1. The column «Partener».** A column of the list's own (`partner` in the page's `columns`, standing right after «Stare» — the third — because at 1280 px the wide table scrolls inside its frame and the last column, where it first stood, fell outside it: the header cut to «Parten», the row's press to «S…»): the partner's name as plain text, nothing on a row without one, for every role that reads the list. It is optional like its neighbours — not essential, so «Coloane» hides it per browser — but, unlike the address and «Trimis», which the wide table drops below `lg`, it stays on the wide table at every width the table is drawn (`hideBelow: "md"`): the owner asked to see and to select in the grid, and a landscape tablet or a small laptop between 900 and 1199 px is that grid too. Its bounded width keeps it narrow there, and the table scrolls inside itself before the page would. On a phone it is a labelled line of the card, as every column is, but only on a row that has a name or the press (a new opt-in of `AdminTable`, `omitEmptyOnPhone`: an empty optional value gets no line; every other column keeps its line on every row). Its «?» says what it is, that the person is not told, and how it is set. A name of 120 characters wraps anywhere inside a column bounded on the wide table, so it widens neither the table nor the page at 320 px. The invitations drawn above the registrations (the lead rows) put their send's partner in the same column. **With the column in place, the chip «Partener: {name}» leaves the list's name cell** — rows and lead rows — because the column says it; every other screen keeps its chip exactly as it was: the registration's page, the internal list's line, «Invitații». `StatusChip`'s opt-in `wrap` stays the partner chips' alone; its source scan now finds the three that remain.

**2. Sort and filter.** The column sorts (`?sort=partner`, one of the repository's sort keys): by the name without regard to case (`lower(partner_name)`), the rows without a partner last in both directions, then the list's own order (newest first, then the id) — so one partner's people stand together at the top. The tick «De la parteneri» becomes one select in the same place, with the same handshake: «Toate înscrierile» (no filter), «De la orice partener» — exactly what the tick did, and still `partner=1`, so every link written before keeps working — and, with one event chosen, each partner's name used at that event, from the same read as the boxes' suggestions (`listPartnerSuggestions`). A chosen partner rides in a parameter of its own, `partnerName`, validated on the server (`partner-mark.ts#chosenPartnerOf`): a name among the chosen event's partners, compared without regard to case and carried on in the event's own spelling; anything else — unknown at the event, over 120 characters, empty, a list of values, or any name while every event is listed — is ignored, never an error page. It is one more condition in the list's one `WHERE` (`lower(partner_name) = lower($1)`), so the rows, the count, the summary strip, the pages, the sort links, both export links (Excel and CSV) and every other filter — «Reconfirmare» included — follow it, and «Șterge filtrele» and the lead rows know it. The export route validates the parameter the same way, so the file of a list filtered to one partner holds exactly that partner's rows. The select is a small island only because its three choices post under two names. Its partners are the boxes' suggestions, the same one read: the names used at the event on registrations, on internal-list lines and on invitations, each once, the newest fifty. So it may offer a partner nobody is registered under yet — choosing it shows an empty list, which is a true answer — and a partner older than the fiftieth is not offered, and its name in the address is ignored as any unknown name is. Accepted for a club with a handful of partners, rather than a second query only for the filter.

**3. The partner set from the row.** For the role that may set the label today — exactly `setRegistrationPartner`'s rule, the Administrator and above (`canManageRegistrations`) — the cell carries one compact press, «Alege» or «Schimbă» (44 px to touch, a real button whose accessible name says whose partner it is and begins with the word it shows — «Alege partenerul pentru {name}» on a row with none, «Schimbă partenerul pentru {name}» on a row with one — so voice control can press what it sees: WCAG 2.5.3, label in name, as the site's other presses). It opens a small dialog for that row, in the shape of the row's «Adaugă o notă»: a native select with «Fără partener» and the event's partners already used, and a short box for a partner not yet among them. A name typed in the box wins over the select; «Fără partener» with an empty box clears. The two become the tick and the box of every other form (`partnerMarkOfRow`) and then go through the same `parsePartnerMark` — the same trim and the same 1–120 limit, refused at the box with what was typed kept — and the same `setRegistrationPartner`: the same audit row (`registration.partner_set`, whether a name is now present, never the name), the same refusals. The server action, `setRegistrationPartnerFromListAction`, sits beside the registration page's own press in `partner-actions.ts` and asserts the role itself (BR-REQ-060-01); the press is drawn only for that role as a courtesy. A save comes back to the same list — the same event, filters, sort, page and page size, only the list's query travelling — with the sentence the registration's page toasts: «Partenerul a fost salvat», «Nu mai e de la parteneri» or «Era deja așa; nimic de schimbat», said in the list's alert too, so «unchanged» is never read as «Salvat.» (the same keys; a line's fold, which wrote the first and the last already, now says its sentence there as well). The way back carries `from=row`, so the internal list's panel, which those keys open after a line's own fold, stays as it was. The dialog closes when the list is drawn again after a save — its key holds the row's partner, the outcome and the page's own render instant, so a second «Era deja așa» in a row closes it too instead of leaving it over the refreshed list; a refusal draws no new page and keeps it open with what was typed.

**The suggestions are read once per page.** The page reads the chosen event's partners once and hands the same array to the filter, to every row's dialog and to the internal list's boxes, which read it a second time before; never one read per row. The invitations' send form, a panel of its own, keeps its own read, as it did. With every event listed the page does what its other event-bound tools do — the internal list, the invitations, the one-press entry onto the waiting list, the sponsors' file: nothing event-bound is offered. The column shows the names and sorts, the filter offers «de la orice partener», and the row's press waits until one event is chosen; the column's «?» says so.

**Who may.** Everyone who reads the list (the Organizer and above) sees the column, sorts by it and filters by it. Setting it from the row is the Administrator's, as on the registration's page; the Organizer, the Tehnic role and every desk-only role are refused on the server with nothing written and no audit row, and are handed no press. The Organizer still sets it on a line of the internal list, as before.

**What does not change.** The label stays a label: no state, place, hold, deadline, allocator or capacity term reads it; it is on no public page, in no email, not on the race-day desk and not in the sponsors' file — `partner-never-leaves.test.ts` holds, its reader list unchanged (the two new islands are handed strings and name none of it). The registration's page keeps its card; the Excel and the CSV keep their column «Partener» where it was. No migration (the column exists, and the club's list is a few hundred rows), no dependency, no legal text or template.

**Refused in version one.**
- **Setting the partner on many rows at once** — ticking several rows and naming one partner for them. It is the natural next step: a partner's group often arrives as one list of names. It is not here because the list's ticks today belong to the bulk cancel, whose form owns them, and a second verb on the same ticks needs its own form, its own confirmation and an audit row per registration — a change of its own, not a column.
- **A partner directory with its own table** — the names to pick from kept apart, renamed in one place. A name typed with the event's earlier names offered is enough for a club, and the select is exactly those names; a table would need a screen to keep it, as «De la parteneri» already decided.

**Tested.** On PGlite (`tests/integration/registrations/partner-column.test.ts`): the column and its hint, the chip gone from the list's rows and lead rows, a 120-character name; the sort both ways with the rows without a partner last and the case ignored, kept across pages and filters; the filter by any partner and by one, combined with a state, «Reconfirmare» and a search, the count, the summary and the pagination under it, an unknown or over-long name and a name with every event listed ignored; both export links carrying it and the files holding exactly that partner's rows; the press's accessible name holding its visible word on every row, in both languages; the row's action for every role — the Administrator and the Superadministrator set, change, clear and get «unchanged», back on the same list, with the audit row; every other role refused with nothing written and no audit row; the typed name winning; the suggestions read once for a page of rows. `partner-mark-screens.test.ts` walks the column and the select where it walked the chip and the tick, the chip still on the registration's page. In a browser (`tests/e2e/partner-mark.spec.ts`, 320 px and desktop, against a production build): the column with a partner's name, «Coloane» hiding and showing it, the Administrator setting a partner from the row by the select (the press «Alege…») and by a new typed name (the press «Schimbă…») and coming back on the same filters, the filter narrowing the list to one partner, the Organizer seeing the column with no press, and no sideways overflow at 320 px with a long name.
changelogLine: - **«Partener» on the registrations list** — the partner's name in a column of its own, sortable, hideable from «Coloane»; the filter «De la parteneri» becomes one select (any partner, or one partner of the chosen event, in the export too); and the Administrator sets a row's partner from the list, picked from the event's partners or typed new. The chip «Partener: {name}» leaves the list's name column and stays everywhere else. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given registrations with and without a partner's name, then the registrations list shows the name as plain text in a column of its own, «Partener» (with a hint, hideable from «Coloane», a phone line only where there is a name or a press, a 120-character name wrapping without widening the page at 320 px), the invitations above the rows putting theirs in the same column, and no chip «Partener: {name}» in the list's name cell; `?sort=partner` orders by the name without regard to case, the rows without one last in both directions; the filter offers all registrations, any partner (`partner=1`) and, with one event chosen, each of its partners (`partnerName`, validated against the event's partners and otherwise ignored), in the list's one `WHERE`, so the rows, the count, the summary, the pages, the sort links and both export files follow it (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the registrations list with one event chosen, when the Administrator or the Superadministrator saves a row's partner from its press (its accessible name beginning with its visible word, «Alege…» or «Schimbă…», in both languages) — picked from the event's partners, typed new (the typed name winning) or «Fără partener» — then it goes through `setRegistrationPartner` with its audit row and comes back to the same list (event, filters, sort, page and page size) saying saved, cleared or unchanged; the Organizer, the Tehnic role and every desk-only role get no press and are refused FORBIDDEN by the action on the server, with nothing written and no audit row (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
